backend/main.mo: Motoko backend implementing user profiles, access-controlled profile updates, user search, and conversation/message management.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence reports mapping feature IDs to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten one‑sentence summaries for all main frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base and theme variables defining light/dark mode color tokens and global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file mounting the React application and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component that handles identity initialization and routes users to sign-in or the main chat layout.
frontend/src/components/ChatLayout.tsx: Main authenticated layout that loads the user profile, manages conversations, and renders header, sidebar, and active chat view.
frontend/src/components/ChayanHeader.tsx: Header with branding, new-chat button, user menu, edit-profile dialog trigger, and sign‑out handling.
frontend/src/features/chat/ConversationV: Renders the active conversation header, message timeline, composer, and privacy menu for the selected contact.
frontend/src/features/chat/MessageCompos: Message input box that sends encrypted messages using useSendMessage and supports Enter-to-send behavior.
frontend/src/features/chat/MessageTimeli: Displays message history for a recipient with auto-scroll, decryption handling, and delete support for the sender.
frontend/src/features/contacts/NewChatDi: Searches for users and lets the user start a new chat by selecting a returned principal/name pair.
frontend/src/features/conversations/Conv: Renders sorted conversations and allows selecting a contact to view its messages.
frontend/src/features/messages/useDelete: React Query mutation that deletes a message via the actor and invalidates the recipient's message query.
frontend/src/features/messages/useSendMe: Encrypts and sends a message to a recipient, then invalidates the message query for that conversation.
frontend/src/features/privacy/Conversati: Provides a menu to clear local encryption keys or delete the selected conversation with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/features/profile/EditProfil: Dialog for editing and validating a user's display name and saving it via mutation.
frontend/src/features/profile/useCurrent: Loads or initializes the user's profile, and provides a mutation to update the display name.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for searching users and fetching/decrypting messages using actor calls and browser crypto utilities.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme variables and base styles.
frontend/src/lib/crypto/chayanCrypto.ts: Implements simple local XOR-based encryption and decryption plus key generation and conversation ID derivation.
frontend/src/lib/storage/localKeyStore.t: Manages localStorage-stored encryption keys, including clearing and existence checks.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider wrappers.
frontend/src/screens/SignInScreen.tsx: Renders the sign-in screen with Internet Identity login, error handling, and informational UI.
frontend/src/state/conversationsStore.ts: Zustand store persisting conversations and tracking the selected contact with add/update/remove utilities.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-safe parsing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom OKLCH color system, extended animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animation.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state with versioning, feature list, and high-level plan for building the privacy-focused chat app chayan.
